messages:
kai: spike in apiserver 5xx in eu-ndc1 at ~09:05 UTC, controller-manager losing leader lease.
nora: seeing etcd leader flips every 15-30s, some nodes reporting high RTTs. GPU onboarding jobs are piling up.
sre-oncall: logs show dial tcp timeouts to etcd. any recent network changes in eu-ndc1?
net-admin: we made a NAT autoscale tweak at 09:03 to add ephemeral SNAT ports; changeID=nat-ops-772.
ops-lee: rolled change out to improve throughput for image pulls. rolling back now while we triage.

kai: apiserver snippets:

```
E0326 09:06:11.009 proxy.go:45] error proxying to etcd: dial tcp 10.2.9.17:2379: i/o timeout
I0326 09:06:26.213 leaderelection.go:66] lost lease, will retry
```

sre-oncall: enabling sticky SNAT on natgw as a quick mitigation.
net-admin: sticky SNAT enabled by @sre-oncall at 09:11 UTC.

nora: RTTs down to ~25ms after sticky SNAT. leader stabilized, controller-manager reacquired lease.
ops-lee: pausing eu-ndc1 GPU onboarding queue and routing new onboarding jobs to eu-central for 30m.

```
# curl -X POST https://infra-api/prov/route -d '{"from":"eu-ndc1","to":"eu-central","filter":"onboarding=true"}'
```

deploy-bot: rollback of nat-ops-772 by @ops-lee at 09:13 UTC :white_check_mark:.

sre-oncall: increasing controller-manager leader election retry interval to 20s to avoid flapping while network team stabilizes.
kai: adding backoff to GPU attach retries to reduce thundering: set 30s initial backoff.

```
kubectl -n kube-system patch cm gpu-autoscaler --patch '{"data":{"attach_backoff":"30s"}}'
```

nora: collecting perf graphs (apiserver latency, etcd leader changes, natgw errors) and attaching to INC-3345.
sre-oncall: monitoring window 45m. keep sticky SNAT until staging validates fix. if stable for 25m we re-enable onboarding slowly.
